summary: Facepalm: Facepalm scan for 2026-10-06. Search capacity ran out partway through, so there is only one candidate. It is solid: the Maricopa County, Ariz., vendor that mailed 3,126 early ballots six days ahead of schedule. Two accepted publishers cover it (KJZZ and KTAR), I opened both pages, and both quotes matched the page text exactly. The event (Oct. 1 mailing, announced Oct. 4) falls within the window for this scan date. The subject is the institution (the county recorder's office and the vendor it hired), not a politician, so party is null. Other stories in the window were set aside: some lacked accepted sources, others fell after the scan date or weren't clear blunders. Genius: I'm submitting no genius candidates for the 2026-10-06 scan. The tool limit was reached before I could open two accepted-publisher pages for any lead, and I won't put forward a story or quote I haven't checked against an opened page. The best lead for a later run is the Air Force Academy push-up record (around Oct. 3–5, Colorado Springs). It needs coverage found on an accepted outlet such as gazette.com, koaa.com or kdvr.com. The second is the Sky Elements drone-show record (around Oct. 4–5, Texas), which needs accepted Texas outlets. The Halzen physics Nobel is in the window but is already published for Oct. 10, and Deisseroth is already on the bench. Pair published.
